facts.text: The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet: a large cinematic hero image at the top, a row of three full-body turnaround views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK, and a bottom row of close-up detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

In the hero panel, an adult character stands full-body on a wet paved walkway at night during rain; metal railings run along both sides, and a building with warm lit windows and streetlights is visible behind.
The character wears a dark charcoal/black high-collared tactical jacket with straps and buckles, a dark undershirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The character's dark hair is short at the sides and gathered into a small bun or topknot at the back, visible in the side and back panels.
The FACE panel shows a close-up of the character's head and shoulders with a neutral, serious expression and a visible scar crossing one eyebrow.
The HANDS panel shows two hands with relaxed, slightly curled fingers and faint dark tattoo-like markings on the hands and fingers.
The BOOTS panel is a close-up of black lace-up leather combat boots with scuffed, wet-looking surfaces and thick soles.
The JACKET COLLAR panel shows the jacket's raised collar, fabric texture, and a buckle/strap detail.
The turnaround row shows the same character in front, left-facing side profile, and back views on a plain dark gray studio background.
In the hero panel, the character stands with feet apart, torso angled slightly toward the left, head turned further left, and arms hanging at the sides.
The hero image uses cool blue-gray night lighting with visible rain streaks and warm orange accents from distant windows and streetlights.
The overall palette is dominated by black and charcoal, with cool blue-gray night tones, muted skin tones, and warm amber highlights.

card.summary: A photorealistic multi-panel character reference sheet for a single adult character in dark tactical clothing, shown in a rainy nighttime urban hero shot plus front, side, back, face, jacket collar, hands, and boots reference panels.

subjects.descriptor: Adult character with a lean build, short dark hair shaved at the sides and gathered into a small bun or topknot at the back, and a scar through one eyebrow.
attributes: short dark hair with shaved/faded sides and a small bun or topknot at the back
dark charcoal/black high-collared tactical jacket with straps and buckles
faint dark tattoo-like markings on the hands and fingers
pose: Hero panel: standing full body on a wet walkway, torso angled slightly left, head turned left, arms relaxed at the sides.
Front panel: standing facing the camera with arms down.
Side profile panel: standing in profile facing left.
Back panel: standing facing away from the camera with arms down.

card.environment: Nighttime urban walkway in rain, with wet reflective pavement, metal railings on both sides, and a building with warm lit windows and streetlights in the background; turnaround and detail panels use a plain dark gray studio backdrop.
card.lighting: Hero image: cool blue-gray night lighting with rain streaks and warm orange practical lights; reference panels: low-key studio lighting with soft highlights.
card.framing: Vertical composite reference sheet; large full-body hero at top, second row with front/side/back full-body views, bottom row with close-up face and clothing/boot details.
card.style: Photorealistic cinematic character concept reference sheet.
card.characterisation: Dark tactical/combat styling with a neutral, serious screen presence.
card.camera: Mixed full-body, profile, and close-up detail shots.

limitations: The static image cannot establish motion, camera movement, sound, music, voice, or dialogue.
Darkness and rain obscure some background and material details.
Exact tattoo patterns and the precise extent of the eyebrow scar are partly unclear.
